text:
jess: Hey team - Marketing is finalizing the launch blog + webinar (Wed 2026-04-15). We need a small verified benchmark appendix: p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), and cost per 1M tokens. Can eng/runtime run a reproducible sweep and sanity-check the methodology?

sam: Happy to. Give me the model list, seq buckets, and which clouds/hw to compare. Also: do you need raw traces or just aggregated CSV + command lines?

maria: Priority models: redwood-small (fp16), redwood-large-gguf-int8, and llama2-13b as a neutral baseline. Seq lengths: 64, 256, 1024. Batches: 1, 8. HW: a100-80gb (primary) and g5. We want raw logs + summary CSVs. Please include exact commit, seed, and any pre/postprocessing.

sam: Cool. We'll do a quick smoke tonight (single run each) and a proper sweep Friday (5 runs per combo, warmup 20 tokens). Payloads: use marketing_scrubbed.csv in s3 plus a synthetic uniform-length payload set for normalization.

noah: Tiny ask from PMM/legal: callouts must read "measured on X hardware under configuration Y; see artifacts for full details". Also can we include a reproducibility one-liner?

sam: Yes - we'll include a one-liner and a 2-line methodology blurb for the appendix. Proposed smoke command (putting in infra runbook):

```
python infra/bench/run_bench.py \
  --model {model} \
  --variant {variant} \
  --batch {batch} \
  --seq {seq} \
  --runs {runs} \
  --seed 42 \
  --hw {hw} \
  --payloads s3://redwood-marketing/marketing_scrubbed.csv \
  --emit-raw-logs s3://redwood-marketing/bench-raw/1831002222/
```

sam: Output artifacts I'll attach: summary CSV (cols: model_variant, hw, batch, seq, p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1M_tokens), raw logs tarball, git commit hash + pip freeze, and the exact CLI for each run.

jess: Timeline: smoke by EOD today, full sweep by Thu EOD so analytics can review before the deck freeze Fri. Can you prioritize?

sam: Will queue smoke now. Full sweep scheduled Thu AM, priority high. I'll post intermediate summaries in this thread.

bench-bot: job 1831002222-smoke queued by sam on a100 pool. ETA ~45m

sam: Smoke completed. Quick numbers (seq256 batch1, a100): redwood-small fp16 p50 18ms p95 46ms tokens/sec 1500. redwood-large int8 p50 65ms p95 140ms tokens/sec 580. llama2-13b fp16 p50 72ms p95 180ms tokens/sec 520. Raw: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-raw/1831002222/; commit: c3f9d7a; seed: 42.

maria: Nice. Can you add a short note about variability (warmup, instance noise) and the warmup protocol for the deck?

sam: Added: "Measurements are median over N runs after a 20-token warmup; results vary with instance placement, background IO, and model initial cache state. See raw artifacts for per-run traces."

noah: Thanks—that language looks safe for the blog. Jess will slot the appendix and include the reproducibility one-liner.

jess: Great work, team. Please keep this thread updated when the full sweep artifacts land. :rocket:
